personality_one_liner: A warm, human-centric mobility experience that feels like interacting with tactile 3D clay miniatures on a vibrant, friendly town map.

spacing.rule: Generous and bouncy spacing. Avoid cramped dense data. Allow elements to float freely.

screens.name: Splash
screens.purpose: Animated vehicle moving through stylized town to establish the brand's friendly vibe.

states.loading: Animated 3D clay vehicle bouncing on route

screens.layout: Full-bleed animated claymorphism illustration of an Indian town. Bouncing logo in the center.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Interactive isometric mini-city showing nearby rides with localized language toggle and voice-assistant button.

states.empty: No rides nearby - soft illustration of a sleeping auto-rickshaw
states.error: Offline - character holding a broken cable

screens.layout: Header: Brand logo + EN/BN/HI toggle + Voice Search Fab (accentMint). Body: Full-screen isometric map image. Overlaid floating 'ride bubbles' (soft 3D pins) representing autos/bikes. Bottom: Floating rounded search container 'Where to?' with thick padding and soft shadows.

screens.name: Vehicle Selection
screens.purpose: Circular floating selector to pick from e-rickshaw, shared auto, bike taxi, local bus, or car.

states.empty: No vehicles found in this category

screens.layout: Bottom sheet format, replacing traditional lists with a circular or horizontal paging carousel of large 3D vehicle cards. Matte clay UI, heavily rounded edges. Tap a vehicle to pop it forward.

screens.name: Fare
screens.purpose: Smart fare slider allowing users to adjust price for faster pickup.

states.loading: Calculating best fare with soft bounce animation

screens.layout: Central focus on an interactive, thick slider. Left side: Lower price (longer wait). Right side: Higher price (instant pickup). Display wait time visualization as floating bubbles above the slider track.

screens.name: Booking
screens.purpose: Tap & hold interaction to confirm the ride, reducing accidental taps and feeling intentional.
screens.layout: Minimal interface. Central large button that says 'Press & Hold to Book' with an animated progress ring that fills up as the user holds. Haptic feedback increases in intensity.

screens.name: Tracking
screens.purpose: Live tracking with dotted path and a real map, overlaid with friendly UI.
screens.layout: Real map in background. Animated dotted route line. Driver info in a thick, pill-shaped floating card at the bottom. The vehicle marker is a customized 3D icon.

screens.name: Completion
screens.purpose: Emotional reward UI upon ride finish with rating system.
screens.layout: Celebratory animation (confetti or stars popping out). Large friendly star rating. 'Thank You' in the local language selected. Button to return to home.

instructions_to_main_agent: Apply a strict CLAYMORPHISM aesthetic: No thin borders or glassmorphism. Use thick, soft shapes with heavy corner radii (md: 20, lg: 32, pill: 999).

To achieve claymorphism in React Native without complex shaders, use nested containers with multiple offset drop shadows, or light top-inner borders paired with soft bottom-outer shadows to simulate depth.
Implement the 'Tap & Hold' button using react-native-gesture-handler with Reanimated to animate a progress ring and trigger haptics progressively.
For the fare screen, build a thick, tactile custom slider where moving the thumb affects both price text and wait time text.
Use deep indigo (surfaceInverse) for primary buttons to contrast strongly against the off-white beige (surface), and use terracotta (brandSecondary) for warm accents.
Add a language toggle (EN/BN/HI) in the Home screen header. Ensure text elements accommodate varying string lengths for Bengali/Hindi translations.
Default to large hit areas (minimum 56pt) to support accessibility in tier-2/3 cities.
Ensure all fonts use Fredoka for display and Nunito for text, enforcing the friendly, rounded aesthetic.
